# Rules and what enforces them

Each row is a rule the code has to keep true and the thing that fails when it doesn't. When a mistake keeps coming back, fix it at the highest level that works: architecture (one way to do it), then types, then a lint whose error names the fix, then a test, and docs only for judgment calls. Lint rules live in `scripts/dev/lint_rules/` and run through `scripts/dev/lint.py`; `python3 scripts/dev/lint.py --explain <id>` prints one in full. Everything else is registered in `.agents/rules.json`.

| Rule | Level | Enforces | Enforcer | Runs in | Owner doc | Proof |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
